sources.snippet: This is Xananthium's Heretic abliteration of REDCELL, a Gemma 4 26B-A4B model. We used Heretic's magnitude-preserving orthogonal abliteration with rank-3 corrections, pinned to commit 66a952b49b00bfd1854bdad769fee5fb225b53be. A local compatibility adapter exposed Gemma 4's fused experts as individual linear projections during research.
